title: Château Montebello

terrainReference.basis: Terrain near the principal Fairmont Le Château Montebello building.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap; NRCan CanVec building outline under ODbL 1.0
mapIdentity.scope: The named 50-point CanVec hotel outline records the six wings, polygonal end bays and later attached expansions. The six-sided original rotunda is placed at the junction.

note: The July 1930 riverside postcard sets the timber profile and stone foundation visible at the dining wing and Wing C. The building owner and heritage register identify the radial plan and the material.
